description: This PHP class 'AttendanceHelper' provides methods for updating timezone offsets in attendance records within the OrangeHRM system, including a timezone map for various global regions.

classes.name: AttendanceHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing attendance timezone offsets in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AttendanceHelper with a database connection.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new QueryBuilder instance.

methods.name: updatePunchInTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Updates the punch-in timezone name based on the provided offset and timezone.

methods.name: updatePunchOutTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Updates the punch-out timezone name based on the provided offset and timezone.
